patterns: Examine the individual attached game-art cards in the given order. Return abstract visual pattern facets only. SubjectPosition is the location of the main subject centroid, not the camera angle; use center for a centered composition. BackgroundColor is the dominant background hue, excluding the subject. Backdrop describes the area BEHIND the subject, not the supporting surface: plain=flat solid; gradient=smooth color transition; pattern=visible repeated or radial graphic geometry; surface-continuation=the supporting plane continues through the background without a rear backdrop; environment=recognizable scenery or architectural context. Natural wood grain on a tabletop is a material texture, not a graphic backdrop pattern. For patterned backdrops classify actual geometry: circles=concentric circles/rings, rays=radial wedges, stripes=straight parallel lines, waves=curved repeating bands, checker=grid of alternating squares, repeated-motifs=icons or repeated ornamental symbols, geometric=other geometric pattern, organic=other organic repeating pattern. Pattern MUST be none when backdrop is not pattern, and MUST NOT be none when backdrop is pattern. Do not describe subjects or confuse object markings with background patterns. Ignore card borders, stars and UI. Image manifest: {{images}}
